name: 金属镜面线控蓝牙耳机款
description: 深色科技风镜面金属线控蓝牙耳机套图：声学卖点、降噪对比与多场景覆盖

styleLock.backgroundSystem: 深色科技场（碳黑+斜向光痕）与浅色纸纹圆角卡片交替；统一圆角面板语言

styleLock.presentationRules: 铬金属镜面高光呈现稳定；产品实拍镜位保持 3/4 主视角家族；信息图一律正俯平视版式
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark-tech premium audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of carbon black #1C1C1E, paper white #F7F5F2, light grey panel #E9E9EB with vivid orange #FF5A2C as the only accent; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif short headlines with eyebrow small caps and short sublines; alternating dark charcoal tech backdrops with subtle diagonal light streaks and light paper-grain rounded cards; cool studio lighting with metallic rim highlights on chrome surfaces and soft contact shadows; thin-line white icons centered in orange #FF5A2C circular badges with a thin metallic ring; stable chrome product rendering with mirror highlights and a consistent hero angle family; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.textZone: 左上 30% 区域：眉题小字「{selling_point_1}」+白色大标题「{callout_1}」+橙色短下划线；右上角小橙色同心圆点缀
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 low hero angle, {product} placed in the lower right with both earbuds and cable fully visible, the product filling 50-60% of the frame as the anchor of one balanced composition. Low-key directional lighting, cool rim highlights tracing the chrome housings, soft contact shadow under the product. Carbon black #1C1C1E backdrop with subtle diagonal light streaks. Upper left text zone: small white eyebrow label 「{selling_point_1}」 above a large white headline 「{callout_1}」 with a short orange #FF5A2C underline, with small orange concentric-circle accents top right completing the layout. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logos, no watermark, no extra text, no garbled characters, no decorative clutter, no floating product without contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 源为 11 片 800x1200 详情长图切片（_sources/耳机 (2)/panels）。主品为带线金属镜面线控蓝牙耳机，与源文件夹「数码/耳机」品类一致，无需纠正。映射：片01→shot-01 主视觉；片02/03 图标区合并→shot-02；片03下半+04→shot-03 横幅；片05→shot-04 声场；片06→shot-05 爆炸微距；片07上半→shot-07 数据环、片07下半+08上半合并→shot-06 降噪对比；片08下半+09上半→shot-08 线控；片09下半+10→shot-09 睡眠场景；片11→shot-10 场景宫格与 shot-11 CTA 收口。已剥离：源文案主张（如八核发声、杜比音效等）、芯片与蓝牙版本参数、提升80/90/99% 数据、会员二维码与店铺促销角标、睡眠模特面部（改为不可识别面部的通用人物）。所有数值类背书均走 {callout} 文案槽，由使用方填入真实数据，模版不发明任何数据。小字副文部分模糊，按版式结构（标题+一行副文）推断。
